versions.changelog:
Initial release of yijing-divination: an interactive I Ching (易经) divination tool powered by AI.

- Provides four divination methods: coins, time, numbers, and random.
- Integrates DeepSeek AI for in-depth reading of hexagrams.
- Activates with various keywords; presents interactive UI via embedded Canvas or direct link.
- Offers automatic user registration and API key provisioning on first use.
- API endpoints cover casting and interpretation of hexagrams, with clear token costs.
- Designed for engaging conversational and interactive user experience.
